name: Collage explainer
liked: What the creator said they liked about the reference, in their words.
summary: One paragraph: the feel, in plain words (dense paper-collage explainer: cut-out photos on textured paper, highlighter swipes on key words, slow push-ins, a new element about every second).

pacing.rhythm: How busy each shot is: e.g. one new element about every second inside a shot; holds of 3-4 s on a finished card.

look.name: Collage explainer
look.description: Written for the compose.py look question.

font._note: woff2 files, relative to youtube-edit/styles/ (compose.py serves them as woff2)

roles.highlight: the swipe behind the key word

rules: Only the open-licence fonts named here; the reference's own typeface is not ours to use.

techniques.name: Key word gets a highlighter swipe
Headline opens big, then settles at the top
Slow push-in on the detail being explained
Photo cut-outs slide in on paper with a drop shadow

maps_to.plan: HyperFrames component: PNG cut-out (remove-background), 6 px offset shadow, slides 40 px with a 0.35 s back.out ease; build it during the first video in this style.

transitions.name: Hard cuts on the beat, a paper-tear wipe between sections

texture: Paper grain, slight vignette, no gradients.

sound.music: Plucky, mid-tempo, ducks under the voice.
sound.sfx: Paper rustle on each cut-out; a pop on the highlight.

do: One idea per shot; label everything that matters.
dont_copy: Their logo, mascots, illustrations, footage, music and sound logo
Their exact layouts frame for frame
Their typeface (use the open-licence match above)
